post.title: Why diaper packs rose 32% from 2019 to 2023
post.ig:
Diaper packs rose about 32% from 2019 to 2023. Here's why.
The average pack went from $16.54 (2019) to $21.90 (mid-2023), per NIQ.
Producer prices for diapers and similar products rose about 16% from Jan 2021 to Jan 2026 (BLS PPI). The absorbent gel is made from acrylic acid, which comes from oil-and-gas-based propylene.
In 2023, 47% of families with young kids reported diaper need, and SNAP can't be used for diapers.
Sources: NIQ via Fox Business, BLS via FRED, AP, National Diaper Bank Network, USDA.
News and education, not financial advice.
